cold-email-writer: Write a B2B cold email with a subject line. Use for cold outreach, prospecting emails and sales emails.
cold-email-audit: Review, score and fix a cold email. Use when asked to check a sales email, find spam words, or explain why nobody replies to outreach.
icp-builder: Build an ideal customer profile (ICP) and B2B targeting from a website. Use when asked who to target, buyer personas, or lead list criteria.
email-deliverability-check: Check why emails go to spam. Use for SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks and the exact DNS records to fix.
cold-email-reply-handler: Reply to a prospect who answered a cold email. Use for sales objections, 'not interested', 'send more info' or pricing questions.
